hero.title: About
hero.subtitle: B.Tech IT + MBA at IIIT Gwalior. I build full-stack products and currently work as a Software Engineer intern at QuickIntell.

aboutSections.title: Background
content: I'm Nishant Harkut. I'm in my third year of a B. Tech IT Undergraduate studies at IIIT Gwalior. I started with UI/UX and graphic design — won some college design competitions and did a design internship. That led me into wanting to build the things I was designing, not just mock them up.

aboutSections.title: Design to dev
content: I switched focus to development and started shipping full-stack projects: a Web3 collaboration platform, an AI travel planner, a career-coaching SaaS. I've competed in hackathons — top 10 at ODOO India (out of 10,000+ teams) and first place at Hacknovate 6.0.

I'm currently interning at QuickIntell as a Software Engineer: OCR pipelines, backend services, and AI integrations for their healthcare RCM product. I use React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, and sometimes Three.js and GSAP when the project needs it.

aboutSections.title: Security
content: I'm learning web application security in parallel — OWASP basics, auth, API security. Not my main focus, but I'd rather build things knowing how they can break.

aboutSections.title: Off the keyboard
content: Basketball, gym, AI music experiments. I still do graphic design and photography, and I play BGMI when I want to switch off.
